external_buyer_decomposition_note: wallet-level totals; endpoint attribution out of scope (probe header)

verification.method: light single-address re-read per hit wallet, exact-match required

window_read.note: v6: RPCs enforce 10k-block span limits; full-window reads are deterministically sliced, union == window. v9: a slice the node rejects BY SIZE (-32020 'backend response too large' / free-plan range cap / HTTP 408) fast-fails and is re-walked in 400-block sub-slices, union == slice; size-fail at 400 blocks aborts.

tripwire_group0.method: second independent chunked heavy pass over group 0, per-member exact match incl. zero-count wallets
